semaforo_indicator.concept: Evaluación automatizada de salud del negocio en 3 niveles

GREEN.title: Negocio en Excelente Estado
GREEN.meaning: Ventas estables, margen positivo (>25%), stock saludable.

YELLOW.title: Atención Requerida
YELLOW.meaning: Pocos productos con stock bajo o ligera baja en ventas respecto a semana previa.

RED.title: Acción Urgente Requerida
RED.meaning: Múltiples productos agotados o margen negativo en últimos días.

accessibility_and_testids.rule: Mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select triggers, table rows, modals, tabs).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure all UI text is strictly in Spanish with natural, non-technical everyday wording (e.g. 'Ganancia estimada' instead of 'EBITDA', 'Costo de compra' instead of 'COGS', 'Unidades disponibles' instead of 'SKU On-Hand Quantity').
2. On first login or new business flow, launch the step-by-step Onboarding Modal/Screen before displaying full dashboard.
3. Keep Semáforo indicator prominent at the top of the main dashboard with actionable advice cards below it.
4. Add an AI Assistant Chat Widget (powered by backend endpoint using GPT 5.4 Mini prompt over local business context) accessible via floating button and top header pill.
5. Every data grid or list (Products, Movements, Sales, Purchases, Finances) must include filter controls and a functional 'Exportar CSV' button.
6. Include mock/seed data for new businesses or realistic demo datasets so the semáforo and charts render vibrant insights immediately upon review.
7. Set data-testid on all key buttons, inputs, tables, cards, and navigation links as specified in guidelines.
